followed_sources_checked.notes: Used for BEHAVIOR-1K, SceneFun3D, PhysDreamer lines.
Used for Infinigen Indoors and procedural generation branch.
Used for Holodeck embodied environment generation.
Used for Octo/OpenVLA robot policy baselines.

candidates.title: SceneFun3D: Fine-Grained Functionality and Affordance Understanding in 3D Scenes
candidates.why_candidate: Defines reusable fields Object, Part, Affordance, FunctionalElement, TaskLanguage, MotionParameter for our typed interactive-world representation.

candidates.title: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Human-Centered, Embodied AI Benchmark with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
candidates.why_candidate: Directly informs Task, StatePredicate, GoalCondition, SceneObject, PhysicalProperty, and validation protocol design.

candidates.title: PhysX-Omni: Unified Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Generation for Rigid, Deformable, and Articulated Objects
candidates.why_candidate: Strong candidate for PhysicalProperty, Material, DeformableState, KinematicJoint, and simulator export fields.

candidates.title: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

candidates.title: Feature Splatting: Language-Driven Physics-Based Scene Synthesis and Editing
candidates.why_candidate: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

candidates.title: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
candidates.why_candidate: Baseline for InteractionConstraint, Reachability, Collision, Articulation, and GeneratedScene validity metrics.

candidates.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
candidates.why_candidate: Important baseline for Prompt, SceneSpec, SpatialConstraint, AssetRetrieval, LayoutOptimization, and downstream embodied evaluation.

candidates.title: Infinigen Indoors: Photorealistic Indoor Scenes using Procedural Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.

candidates.title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation
candidates.why_candidate: Directly motivates TaskGenerator, SceneGenerator, SupervisionGenerator, PolicyLearner, and validation-loop abstractions.

candidates.title: SpatialVLA: Exploring Spatial Representations for Visual-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: Useful for Scene.spatial_graph, Ego3DEncoding, SpatialActionToken, and spatial instruction validation.

candidates.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
candidates.why_candidate: Baseline for Policy, Observation, ActionDistribution, GoalImageCondition, and embodiment adaptation.

candidates.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
candidates.why_candidate: Baseline for VLA policy execution, generated-task transfer, action-token interface, and finetuning experiments.

candidates.title: pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
candidates.why_candidate: Sets a high demo-quality target for robot execution, deformable manipulation, long-horizon interaction, and continuous action generation.

candidates.title: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
candidates.why_candidate: Useful for benchmark packaging, generated-task evaluation, policy baselines, and trajectory/data schema design.

candidates.title: OpenEQA: Embodied Question Answering in the Era of Foundation Models
candidates.why_candidate: downstream benchmark for testing whether generated interactive environments preserve object identity, spatial relations, and semantic affordances
